name: Munt la Schera Tunnel
facts: Munt la Schera Tunnel, a single‑lane marvel, stretches 3,394 metres, built in 1965 to haul building materials for the Punt dal Gall dam and opened to the public in 1968.

Traffic flows through the tunnel every 15 minutes under traffic lights, a unique system that alternates directions, with a different schedule on winter Saturdays to keep the 3.6‑metre‑high, 2.5‑metre‑wide road clear.
Since 2008, cyclists are barred from the tunnel, but from June to September they can ride a half‑hourly shuttle bus, while at other times a few spots remain on the public bus service.
